claim_text: The 2021 consensus defines mosaic NF1 as a pathogenic heterozygous NF1 variant with a variant allele fraction significantly below 50% in apparently normal tissue plus one other NF1 criterion, or the identical pathogenic variant in two anatomically independent affected tissues.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Modified Delphi expert consensus (74/76 experts); rubric forbids expert_opinion at strength >=4, so capped at 2. Recommendation, not an empirical finding. | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Mosaic NF1 definition. Same gene-disease relationship as C0023.
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
